headline: India Considers Cutting Import Tariffs on 115 Manufacturing Inputs
summary: The Indian government is evaluating 1% to 3% duty cuts on 115 manufacturing inputs, including textile, electronic, chemical, and engineering goods, to enhance domestic manufacturing.
why: Customs duty adjustments on intermediate components lower input costs for Indian domestic exporters and industrial producers.

impacts.name: Indian Manufacturing Sector
impacts.why: Lower input duties directly reduce raw material costs for industrial producers.
